one_line: Oswal Jain minister-banker of Mewar whose financial networks sustained Maharana Pratap after Haldighati.

appearance.age_look: mid-30s, lean but sturdy build, slightly scholar-like rather than warrior-heavy
appearance.face: oval face with high cheekbones, warm wheatish-brown complexion, sharp nose, neatly trimmed black moustache, thin well-kept beard along the jaw, calm focused eyes with slightly arched brows and a composed yet determined default expression
appearance.hair: black hair kept short and tidy under a neatly wrapped off-white Rajasthani-style pagri with a subtle gold border and a small folded tail to one side, no warrior plume or ornamentation
appearance.costume: a long, knee-length off-white cotton angarkha (wrap-tunic) with side ties and a subtle fine stripe weave, worn over a light cream-coloured muslin shirt; lower body in narrow churidar-style trousers in muted turmeric-yellow; around his shoulders a soft, finely woven, light-ivory dupatta with a thin maroon edging draped accountant-style over one shoulder and across the chest; on his feet simple brown leather mojari shoes with modest upturned toes; at his waist a plain deep-maroon cloth kamarband in which a small fabric pouch is tucked, and he wears understated Jain-merchant jewellery: a single thin gold chain under the angarkha neckline, a simple signet ring on his right hand, and small, practical copper-and-wood counting beads wrapped around his left wrist.
appearance.signature: a sturdy dark-wood portable account chest with brass fittings, carried by a leather shoulder strap, whose lid doubles as a writing board and which is shown open to reveal neatly stacked coin bags, bundled palm-leaf documents, and a wooden ink-and-reed pen set at the ready

ref_desc: Bhama Shah is a mid-30s lean Oswal Jain banker with wheatish skin, short black hair under an off-white pagri, wearing an off-white angarkha, turmeric-yellow churidar, deep-maroon waistband, ivory dupatta, brown mojari shoes, and carrying a dark-wood brass-fitted portable account chest.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Bhama Shah, an Oswal Jain minister-banker of late-16th-century Mewar: a mid-30s, lean yet sturdy man with an oval face, wheatish-brown complexion, sharp nose, neatly trimmed black moustache and a thin beard along the jaw, his expression calm and focused; his short black hair is covered by a neatly wrapped off-white Rajasthani pagri with a subtle gold border and a small folded tail to one side. He wears an era-accurate, modest merchant outfit: a knee-length off-white cotton angarkha with a fine stripe texture layered over a light cream muslin shirt, paired with narrow turmeric-yellow churidar trousers, a deep-maroon cloth kamarband at his waist with a small coin pouch tucked in, and a soft light-ivory dupatta with thin maroon edging draped from his left shoulder across the chest and back in a neat, orderly fashion. On his feet are brown leather mojari with modest upturned toes; jewellery is minimal—a thin gold chain just visible at the neckline, a simple signet ring on his right hand, and a wrap of small copper-and-wood counting beads on his left wrist. His single signature prop is a sturdy dark-wood portable account chest with brass fittings and a leather shoulder strap, shown slung at his side and also in an open view where its lid doubles as a writing board, revealing stacked coin bags, bundled palm-leaf documents, and a wooden ink-and-reed pen set; keep the palette centred on off-white, cream, turmeric yellow, deep maroon, and brown leather, and present him in multiple poses and angles to emphasize the consistent face, pagri, garments, and account chest while maintaining a dignified, historically grounded look.
